definition: OMIM #621535 denotes Spinocerebellar Ataxia 52 (SCA52), an autosomal dominant neurodegenerative disorder associated with variants in the RAB3A gene. Clinically, it is characterized by gait and limb ataxia, nystagmus, and cerebellar atrophy, accompanied by variable manifestations including dysarthria, dysphagia, and urinary urgency.
